params.prompt: Premium Korean mobile-app performance ad key visual for Meta feed, 4:5 vertical. High-end glossy 3D render, studio lighting, soft shadows, crisp details. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people, no hands, no money. IMPORTANT composition: the main object is placed in the LOWER HALF of the frame (from 45% to 88% height), the entire upper 45% is completely empty smooth background, and the bottom 12% is clean. Concept: a missing piece in your protection. A glossy 3D shield made of blue and silver puzzle pieces, one puzzle piece missing and that gap glowing red with a small red alert badge; the missing piece hovers beside it. Clean pastel blue-and-white seamless background, cinematic rim light.
